item: H5 - reconnect refuses without live consent
method: The reconnect path is exercised in three states where it must fail — never paired, after emergency stop, and after the consent record expired — and once in the state where it must succeed. Each refusal requires both a non-ok reply AND no token in it. The positive case is included so the refusals cannot be a dead code path passing by accident.
whyThisExists: Reconnection without a popup code is only safe if consent is genuinely required. Without these four checks, 'remembers the pairing' and 'lets any pinned origin in' look identical from the outside.
